_comment: Relay build backlog for /relay-loop. Each iteration: STAGE 0 triage -> pick highest-leverage todo -> build -> verify (tsc + vitest + real e2e when keys present) -> commit + push. STOP is valid. Free services only. Never touch mcp-forge. Secrets in .env only (gitignored).
product: Relay — text a Telegram bot; an agent + self-hosted anvil-engine browser fetches/processes data from any app and replies. Instinct (instinct.co) competitor. Free-infra MVP.
invariants: Free services only (Telegram long-poll, Gemini free tier, self-hosted anvil).
Do NOT modify C:/Users/acwic/mcp-forge. Merge improvements back via PRs later.
Secrets via .env (gitignored) — reuse redact-secrets; grep before every push.
anvil connect: POST /v1/sessions -> build ws(s)://host/cdp?session=<id>[&token=] yourself -> puppeteer.connect -> POST /v1/sessions/:id/release. Simple fetches: REST /v1/scrape.
LLM behind an adapter interface so Claude swaps in for Gemini in one line.
owner_blockers: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in .env (from @BotFather) — needed for any live/e2e test.
GEMINI_API_KEY in .env (aistudio.google.com/apikey) — needed for the agent loop.
anvil-engine running + reachable at ANVIL_BASE_URL (local `docker run -p 3000:3000 anvil-engine`, or deployed) — needed for browser fetches.
Hosting decision for 24/7 (Oracle Always Free VM recommended) — item deploy-1.

items.task: TS project (package.json/tsconfig/gitignore/.env.example), copied libs (redact-secrets, url-validator), anvil client, telegram transport, stub index, unit test, backlog, README. Pushed to awictor/relay.
anvil client: createSession (builds CDP ws endpoint correctly), releaseSession, withBrowser (puppeteer connect+release), scrape (REST), anvilLive probe. src/anvil.ts.

Agent loop (src/agent.ts): LLM adapter interface (LLMClient) + Gemini free-tier impl using generateContent function-calling. Tools: browse(url)->scrape text, reply(text). Bounded by RELAY_MAX_STEPS. Per-chat short memory (last N turns). Behind interface so Claude swaps in. Unit-test the tool-dispatch + step cap with a mock LLM (no network).

Replace index.ts stub with the agent: inbound msg -> agent.run(chatId, text) -> tools drive anvil -> reply. First real errands: 'top HN story', 'weather in <city>'. e2e verify: text the bot, assert a coherent reply (needs all 3 keys).

Safety: per-chat rate limit (RELAY_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN), step/time caps enforced, SSRF via isUrlSafe on every browse target, dangerous-action guard (mirror auto-scan DANGEROUS regex: delete/pay/logout/purchase/etc.) before any click/submit, redact secrets from anything echoed back or logged.
Richer tools: navigate+click+type via withBrowser (multi-step browsing, not just scrape), extract-structured (ask LLM to pull fields from page text). Keeps step cap + safety guard.

OWNER-GATED infra: stand up 24/7 host. Recommend Oracle Cloud Always Free VM: docker run anvil-engine + pm2/systemd the Relay worker. Health checks. Document exact steps. Until then MVP runs on Alex's machine (anvil local, worker local). Confirm with Alex before relying on any host.
UX: typing indicator (sendChatAction), /start + /help commands, friendly errors, truncation notices, basic usage log.

history.note: Initial scaffold created by the build session (pre-loop). Channel->stub->anvil pipe runnable; agent loop is the next item.
